# HERE

HERE Technologies provides comprehensive location data and mapping services, offering APIs and SDKs for developers to integrate maps, geocoding, routing, and other location-based features into their applications.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/here/.

## Actions

- **Autosuggest Places**: Fetch possible completions for a partial search term.
- **Browse Places**: Search for places around a given location with optional filters.
- **Calculate Fleet Telematics Route**: Calculate a route between waypoints with vehicle profile options.
- **Compute Routing Matrix**: Compute a routing distance/time matrix.
- **Coordinates to Tile Indices**: Convert geographic coordinates to Web Mercator XYZ tile indices.
- **Daily Weather Forecast**: Provide daily weather forecasts (up to 7 days).
- **Discover Places**: Discover places and addresses by free-form text near a location.
- **Geocode Address**: Convert structured address data into geographic coordinates.
- **Get Aerial Tile**: Retrieve a satellite/aerial map tile.
- **Get Astronomy Forecast**: Fetch astronomical data (sunrise, sunset) for a specific location.
- **Get Base Map Tile**: Retrieve a base map tile image without labels.
- **Get Base Map Tile**: Retrieve a base map tile.
- **Get Hybrid Map Tile**: Retrieve a hybrid (aerial + labels) map tile.
- **Get Isolines**: Calculate isolines.
- **Get Label Tile**: Retrieve a label overlay tile.
- **Get Line Overlay Tile**: Retrieve a line overlay tile.
- **Get Map Image**: Retrieve a static map image.
- **Get Meta Info Tile**: Retrieve metadata for a specific map tile.
- **Get POI Tile**: Retrieve a point-of-interest overlay tile.
- **Get Terrain Map Tile**: Retrieve a terrain map tile image.
- **Get Traffic Flow**: Retrieve real-time traffic flow data.
- **Get Traffic Incidents**: Fetch real-time traffic incidents within a specified area.
- **Get Traffic Tile**: Retrieve a traffic overlay tile.
- **Get Waypoint Sequence**: Optimize the visit order of multiple waypoints.
- **Get Weather Observation**: Retrieve current weather observation.
- **Hourly Weather Forecast**: Fetch hourly weather forecasts.
- **Lookup Place Details**: Look up detailed information for a place by its HERE ID.
- **Reverse Geocode Coordinates**: Convert geographic coordinates into a human-readable address.
- **Weather Alerts**: Retrieve severe weather alerts for specified locations or routes.
